children: Overview
China real estate developer's H1 revenue fell 23% yr/yr to RMB36.65 bln
Gross profit margin dropped 4.4 percentage points to 6.2% in H1
Core net profit declined 94.6% yr/yr amid challenging market and destocking
Outlook
Yuexiu Property did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods in the press release
Result Drivers
DESTOCKING IMPACT - Co said increased sales from existing inventory contributed to notable progress in destocking, with contracted sales value falling 17.9%
PROPERTY MARKET MARGINS – Pressure on project margins amid the PRC property-market adjustment cut property-development gross profit

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 16 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the real estate rental, development & operations peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Yuexiu Property Company Limited is HK$5.10, about 38% above its August 27 closing price of HK$3.70
